caption: The drawing depicts a single, small, cylindrical object placed centrally on a plain, light beige background. The object resembles a silver or metal salt shaker or spice container, with a round, perforated top and a stepped, circular base. The object is rendered in shades of gray, with some darker accents suggesting its metallic texture and shadows, adding depth to the drawing. Some text is inscribed on the midsection of the object, though only parts of the words are legible, such as "TROY" and "ALEX". Below and to the left of the object, a handwritten signature is visible, reading "Aaron Foster". There are no other objects or decorations on the beige background.
title: Sander
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
